text:
ANTIFRAUD::geo
Description
This iRules command returns L3 geoIP and geolocation collected by client.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
geo
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"geolocation: [ANTIFRAUD::geo]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0.0
